UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile and cross-device unlock/subscription flags (PII isolated to document owner).

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: User display name from Google Sign-In.

email.description: Verified email address from Google Sign-In.

xFollowed.description: Whether the user unlocked the Resources library via X follow.

notesRequested.description: Whether the user requested the free lecture notes.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

PostProgress.title: PostProgress
PostProgress.description: Per-user learning progress, bookmark, completion status, and personal study notes for a library post.

slug.description: Library post slug matching the document ID.

bookmarked.description: Whether the post is bookmarked by the user.

completed.description: Whether the user marked this post as completed.

lastSection.description: Zero-based index of the last active section.

lastSlide.description: One-based index of the last viewed slide.

note.description: Personal study note for this post.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when progress tracking started.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when progress was last saved.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile and cross-device preferences, readable and writable only by the owner.

/users/{userId}/progress/{postSlug}.description: User-scoped subcollection tracking Watch & Read progress, bookmarks, and personal study notes per post.
